entities.summary: Kazi Abdul Jaleel, popularly known as Amar Jaleel, is a Sindhi fiction writer and columnist whose columns appear in various Sindhi, Urdu and English-language dailies of Pakistan. He has authored 20 books, and received awards including the Pride of Performance, the highest literary award in Pakistan, and Akhal Bharat Sindhi Sahat Sabha National Award (India).
